# Code of conduct

## Our standard

Treat other contributors with respect. Give feedback on the work, not the
person. Accept feedback on your own work without defensiveness.

## Unacceptable behavior

These actions are not allowed:

- Insults, personal attacks, or harassment.
- Sharing another person's private information without consent.
- Sexual language or imagery in project spaces.
- Sustained disruption of discussions or reviews.

## Reporting

Email the maintainer at pangisaac9889@gmail.com — the same address used
for security reports in `.github/SECURITY.md`. The maintainer's GitHub
handle is listed in `CODEOWNERS`. State what happened, when it happened,
and who was involved. Reports are handled in confidence.

## Enforcement

The maintainer reviews each report and decides the response. Responses may
include a warning, a temporary block, or a permanent block from the project.

---

This document is a short, project-local code of conduct. For a longer,
widely adopted standard, adopt the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/) instead and
replace this file with it.
